prompt: Escape room: find the code, open the safe, take the key, unlock the door

intent.setting: A single-storey interior divided into a yard, an entrance, a main room and four side rooms, forming a multi-step escape room
intent.goal: Find the numeric code, open the safe, take the key, and unlock the exit door
intent.fail: Run out of time/lockout without reaching the unlocked exit door
intent.headline: Four linked puzzle beats: code -> safe -> key -> locked door
